subject.title: Suppress duplicate session lock timeout replies

question: Should an incoming turn receive no terminal error when a different actively registered reply run holds the same session lock and is expected to finish the user-visible work?
rationale: The implementation and proof support the proposed distinction, but choosing silence rather than a visible retry/failure is a user-facing message-delivery policy decision.

options.title: Approve correlated silence
options.body: Accept silence only for a different active reply run on the same session, preserving visible failures for ended, same-run, and uncorrelated contention.

options.title: Keep all timeout replies visible
options.body: Reject silent suppression and retain the existing generic failure for every lock timeout until a broader duplicate-turn UX policy is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve correlated silence
recommendation.body: Accept silence only for a different active reply run on the same session, preserving visible failures for ended, same-run, and uncorrelated contention.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the only adjacent Codex test-shard change; a broader current-main history read should identify the session-lock-area owner for the final behavior decision.
